business_model.basis: stated in P1 (Item 4 Business Overview) and P3 (Item 5 Overview)
business_model.claim: StealthGas owns and operates a fleet of LPG carriers that provide international seaborne transportation of liquefied petroleum gas products (propane, butane, butadiene, isopropane, propylene, VCM) to LPG producers and users.
quotes: We own a fleet of LPG carriers providing international seaborne transportation services to LPG producers and users.

Our LPG carriers carry various petroleum gas products in liquefied form, including propane, butane, butadiene, isopropane, propylene and vinyl chloride monomer, which are all byproducts of the production of crude oil and natural gas.

business_model.claim: Principal customers are LPG producers (national, major and independent energy companies and energy traders) and industrial users of LPG products; the three largest customers accounted for 34.1% of 2025 revenues.
quotes: Principal charterers include producers of LPG products, such as national, major and other independent energy companies and energy traders, and industrial users of those products.
For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, our three largest customers accounted for 34.1% and 32.3%, respectively, of our revenues.

business_model.basis: stated in P3 (Item 5) and P1 (Item 4, Chartering of the Fleet)
business_model.claim: Revenue is generated under three charter types: period charters (time and bareboat, lasting up to several years) and spot charters (voyage and short-term time charters, generally one to six months); as of April 1, 2026 no vessels were on bareboat charter.
quotes: We intend to continue to deploy our fleet under period charters including time and bareboat charters, which can last up to several years, and spot market or voyage charters, which generally last from one to six months, subject to market conditions.

As of April 1, 2026, of the 27 operational vessels in our fleet excluding our JV Vessel, three were employed in the spot market, with the remaining vessels deployed on period charters (excluding one vessel laid up due to damages suffered in an explosion incident in July 2025) and none of our LPG carriers were deployed on bareboat charters.
